Package com.foodwaste.backend.service

Class FoodItemService

java.lang.Object
com.foodwaste.backend.service.FoodItemService
@Service public class FoodItemService extends Object
Service class for managing food items. Handles business logic for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting food items. Implements dynamic pricing based on expiry date.

      @Transactional public void deleteFoodItem(Long id)
      Soft delete a food item (marks as deleted instead of removing from database) This preserves order and payment history while hiding the item from listings.
      Parameters:

      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if the food item is not found
